items.commodity_name_az: Təzə Göyçay Narı (Digər təzə meyvələr - Nar)
items.classification_criteria: Whole, fresh, raw, unpeeled pomegranates. Not frozen, not dried, not processed or preserved in sugar.
items.pitfalls: Must NOT be confused with pomegranate juice (falls under Chapter 20: 2009.89.79.00) or dried pomegranate seeds/arils (0813.40). Chapter 8 exclusively covers edible fruits; any chemical preservation or sugar addition shifts to Chapter 20.

items.commodity_name_az: Təbii Nar Şirəsi (Qıcqırdılmamış, əlavə şəkərsiz, Brix > 20)
items.commodity_name_en: Pure Natural Pomegranate Juice (Unfermented, no added sugar, Brix value > 20)
items.classification_criteria: Unfermented juice obtained by pressing pomegranates, without spirit addition, Brix value > 20, no added sugar or sweetening matter.
items.pitfalls: If sugar is added exceeding 30% by weight, it falls under a different sub-code (2009.89.73) with sugar tax implications in EU/EAEU. If fermented, falls under Chapter 22 (wine/cider).

items.commodity_name_az: Ləpələnmiş Meşə Fındığı (Qabığı təmizlənmiş fındıq ləpəsi)
items.classification_criteria: Shelled hazelnut kernels, raw, whether or not blanched or skinned, but not roasted or otherwise cooked.
items.pitfalls: CRITICAL PITFALL: Brokers frequently confuse shelled (0802.22) with in-shell (0802.21). If roasted, salted or flavored, shifts to Chapter 20 (2008.19). Mandatory aflatoxin screening protocol required for EU border controls.

items.classification_criteria: Fresh or dried hazelnuts in their natural outer hard woody shell.
items.pitfalls: Distinguish strictly from shelled nuts (0802.22). Requires physical inspection documentation to confirm shell integrity and humidity < 12%.

items.classification_criteria: Whole, fresh persimmons (Diospyros kaki / virginiana). Not dried, moisture content above 75%.
items.pitfalls: Frequent confusion between FRESH persimmons (0810.70) and DRIED persimmons (0813.40.95). Azerbaijan is a massive exporter of both; dried persimmon is classified under an entirely different heading (0813)!

items.commodity_name_az: Qurudulmuş Xurma və Quru Meyvələr (Qax və Göyçay qurusu)
items.commodity_name_en: Dried Persimmons and other dried fruit
items.classification_criteria: Persimmons dried naturally or mechanically, moisture content typically < 25%, dusted with natural fruit sugars.
items.pitfalls: Do NOT classify under 0810.70 (fresh). If sugar syrup is infused, it reclassifies under Chapter 20 (candied/glacé fruit 2006.00).

items.commodity_name_az: Təzə İstixana Pomidoru (Çəhrayı və qırmızı pomidor)
items.classification_criteria: Fresh or chilled tomatoes (Lycopersicon esculentum). Raw, whole, on vine or loose.
items.pitfalls: Must NOT be crushed, peeled, or cooked (which shifts to Chapter 20: 2002.10 or 2002.90). Must have AQTA quarantine inspection certificate verifying absence of ToBRFV (Tomato Brown Rugose Fruit Virus).

items.commodity_name_en: Tomato Paste / Concentrate (Dry matter 28-30% by weight, no added sugar)
items.classification_criteria: Prepared or preserved tomatoes, pureed and concentrated, dry matter content between 28% and 30%, in aseptic bags or drums.
items.pitfalls: Whole or pieces of peeled tomatoes fall under 2002.10. Tomato puree with dry matter < 12% falls under 2002.90.11. Check dry matter lab certificate.

items.classification_criteria: Fresh whole apples, graded, dessert or processing varieties. Unfermented.
items.pitfalls: Cider apples intended specifically for fermentation have separate sub-headings in some schedules. Apples sliced and dried classify under 0813.30.00.

items.commodity_name_en: Fresh Cherries (Sweet cherries and sour cherries)
items.classification_criteria: Fresh whole cherries, intact stems, unpitted. Fresh or chilled.
items.pitfalls: Cherries preserved in brine or sulfur dioxide fall under Chapter 0812. Cherries preserved in sugar fall under 2008.60.

items.commodity_name_en: Saffron (Crocus sativus), Stigmas and Styles, Neither Crushed nor Ground
items.classification_criteria: Whole stigmas and styles of saffron flower, dried, unground.
items.pitfalls: Ground/powdered saffron falls under 0910.20.90.00. High customs scrutiny for origin authenticity and laboratory purity report.

items.commodity_name_az: Təbii Dağ Balı (Çiçək və cökə balı)
items.classification_criteria: Natural honey produced by bees (Apis mellifera). No artificial sugar or invert syrups added.
items.pitfalls: Artificial honey or honey mixed with other syrups falls under 1702. Veterinary health certificate (AQTA Baytarlıq Şəhadətnaməsi) required instead of phytosanitary certificate.

items.classification_criteria: Fresh whole table grapes in bunches.
items.pitfalls: Dried grapes (raisins / kişmiş) fall under 0806.20. Wine-making grapes shipped in bulk may have specific seasonal restrictions.

items.classification_criteria: Fresh citrus lemons, whole, with or without peel treated with waxes.
items.pitfalls: Feijoa usually falls under 0810.90 (other fresh fruit), while lemons are strictly 0805.50.
